messages:
alex: FYI: between 03:12-03:18 UTC we had a sustained GPU capacity degradation in eu-west. Latency spiked ~4x, queue depth increased, and we saw a handful of requests fall back to cpu-serving which increased cost. :rotating_light:

maria: Logs show slow pod readiness after node attach. Noticed `kubelet` repeatedly timing out on NVML init on two hosts. Stack: nvidia-driver 535.x + CUDA 12.2.

pj: We hit the autoscaler cooldown boundary. Autoscaler saw surge but rejected new node launches because recent evictions bumped our eviction_score threshold. Worth revisiting the safe-margin calculation.

liz_ops: Agreed — our current runbook only covers immediate regional failover. We should add a section for "attach-time degradation" and include pre-warm pool guidance + a fast path to shift light queries to cheaper model variants.

samir: Quick datapoint: cost delta from CPU fallback ~+38% for the 6m window. Also noticed token throttles for a few high-throughput tenants.

alex: Repro steps I used: tailing node logs + repro script that simulates burst. Pasted mini-run here: ```bash
# simulate 200 concurrent sessions
for i in {1..200}; do 
  ./stress-runner --region eu-west --model small --async &
done
```
This reliably surfaced attach latencies.

oncall: incident-bot recorded incident ID: INC-2026-191234. Creating initial timeline in pagerduty.

maria: Proposed runbook edits (high level):
- detect "attach-time > 3s" event and trigger prewarm (warm-pool) if concurrent_attach > 5
- lower autoscaler eviction_score sensitivity during attach storms
- fallback routing: route <5k token requests to low-cost variants automatically
- alert: add `eu-west.gpu.attach-time` with severity=warning at 2s, critical at 5s

pj: +1. Also add a stopper: if cpu-fallback cost delta > 20% for 5m, trigger billing-ops alert and auto-enable scaledown for non-prod.

liz_ops: I'll draft runbook snippets. Example warm-pool trigger (config):
```yaml
warm_pool:
  attach_threshold: 3s
  min_warm_nodes: 4
  prewarm_count: 2
  cooldown: 300s
```
We should keep defaults conservative.

samir: Suggest adding a telemetry dashboard tile for "attach-time distribution" and include percentiles P50/P90/P99 + recent kernel log error counts.

alex: Action items:
- liz_ops: add runbook section + PR with snippet and playbook checklists (ETA: 48h) :memo:
- pj: update autoscaler heuristics PR to reduce eviction sensitivity during attach storms (ETA: 72h)
- maria: add alert rules + grafana tile (ETA: 24h)
- samir: cost rulebook entry for cpu-fallback gating (ETA: 72h)
- oncall: verify warm-pool test run after PRs merged, sign-off (ETA: after merges)

oncall: noted. I'll also schedule a 30m follow-up sync tomorrow 09:30 UTC to review PRs and test plan.

liz_ops: One more note — add a post-incident checklist step to verify driver/kernel compatibility matrix before rolling new driver versions region-wide. We tripped on a driver edge-case.

alex: Good call. For the record: incident mitigated by manual warm-pool increment + temporary traffic steering to AMS for non-sla tenants. No customer-facing downtime but higher cost window.

maria: Filing a bug for NVML init error with the infra team. Link: https://tracker.internal/RED-2891

pj: After autoscaler PR I'll run a 200->400 concurrent soak to validate. Will post logs here.

liz_ops: PRs will mention: playbook id INC-2026-191234 and include a small runbook test harness snippet.

samir: I'll prepare a short RCA doc after the follow-up with metrics and cost summary.

alex: Thanks everyone. If anyone hits blockers on PRs ping me or DM. :thumbsup:
